scripts.typecheck:deps: npm run build -w @fitness/auth && npm run build -w @fitness/domain && npm run build -w @fitness/db
scripts.test: node -e "const { execSync } = require('node:child_process'); const ws = JSON.parse(execSync('npm query .workspace', { encoding: 'utf8' })); if (ws.length) execSync('npm run test --workspaces --if-present', { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.build: node -e "const { execSync } = require('node:child_process'); const ws = JSON.parse(execSync('npm query .workspace', { encoding: 'utf8' })); if (ws.length) execSync('npm run build --workspaces --if-present', { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
